name: Control Center
author: Trevor
description: Control Center: one bar icon that drops a card of tiles for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LocalSend, Do Not Disturb, Night Light, Stay Awake, brightness, volume and peripheral batteries. Rows open the full panels to the side.

barWidget.description: Connectivity, switches, sliders and peripheral batteries behind one icon.

schema.label: Show AirDrop (omdrop)
schema.description: Adds an AirDrop row to the connectivity tile when the omdrop plugin is installed.
